items.title: Itaúna do Sul (PR) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #13
items.en_title: Itaúna do Sul (PR) Works & infrastructure procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #13
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itaúna do Sul (PR) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,120,000; proposals close Nov 24, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
